newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway Jan CPI seen up 0.3 pct m/m. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway Jan CPI seen up 0.3 pct m/m. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]

text.p: Ten economists polled by Reuters expected Norway's consumer price index to rise by an average 0.3 percent month-on-month in January and 2.50 percent year-on-year.
(Corrects expected month-on-month rise to 0.3 percent from 0.03 percent, in headline and text)
The range for the month-on-month estimates was between 0.0 to plus 0.4 percent. The range in the estimated rise from January 1996 to January 1997 was from 2.2 percent to 2.7 percent.
January inflation figures are due on Feb 10 at 0845 GMT.
NOTE - Participating institutions: Orkla Finans, Elcon Securities, Bergen Fonds, Handelsbanken, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, Chase Manhattan Bank, Fondspartner, Fokus Bank, DnB Fonds, I.D.E.A.
